name: NDR Auto Components Ltd
title: NDR Auto Components Ltd - 543214 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 margin record 11.90% and order book INR650 crore (up from INR450 crore) mostly Maruti, but capex is own-program, no capacity-discipline signal; FY30 INR3,000 crore target lacks INR1,000 crore visibility.

capex.quote: we are going to do another INR 40 to INR50 crore to execute our new order book.

triggers.label: Order book INR450 → 650 crore
triggers.quote: our order book as on 31st March 2026 stood at INR650 crore, which also is the highest in the history

triggers.label: FY30 target INR3,000 crore; INR1,000 crore not yet visible
triggers.quote: INR1,000 crore is something I think you will have to give us more time on.

triggers.label: Gross margin lifted by vendor volume discounts
triggers.quote: we have also got some discounts from our vendors that has led to it.

triggers.label: Hayashi JV start delayed April → June
triggers.quote: It is basically because of some operational issues that we have delayed it by two months.

guidance.quote: That should be our guidance till FY '30.
Bharat Seats maybe you can take a INR3,500 crore guidance by FY30.
We do not give annual guidance.

prior_guidance_check.quote: It is basically because of some operational issues that we have delayed it by two months.

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow restated after filing error
red_flags.quote: There was an error in filing has been rectified on 13 th May by filing revised consolidated cashflow

red_flags.label: Evasive on FY27 and new OEM pipeline
red_flags.quote: When something converts, then I think we will share that with you.

evasions.topic: INR1,000 crore of new orders to reach FY30 target
evasions.quote: INR1,000 crore is something I think you will have to give us more time on.
for next year we do not want to share a current guidance because some programs get delayed
When something converts, then I think we will share that with you.
